senses.gloss:
अर्मः,
 
-र्मम् [ऋ-मन् [[Uṇ. 1. 137]]] 
__1 A disease of the eye. 
__2 A country to which one should go (गन्तव्यदेशः or चिरन्तनग्रामनिवासः). 
__3 A cemetery. 
__4 (pl.) Ruins, rubbish; [[Vāj. 30. 11.]]

a. Narrow, thin. 
-कम् 
__1 Narrowness. 
__2 Rubbish, ruins; महावैलस्थे अर्मके [[Rv. 1. 133. 3.]]
n. [ऋ-मनिन्] A disease of the eye (said to be of 5 kinds).
